combo_label: School Days × Magic & Illusion × Sherlock Holmes

entries.clue: Snappy cry that lands just as the cloth whips away
Pick one, lose it in the pack, then watch it come back on top
Tall black headgear that somehow holds a whole rabbit
Yard spell of shrieks and chased footballs, ended by a whistle
Older student handed a badge and a small slice of authority
Ordeal in a silent hall where papers are turned over at a signal
Slim tapered stick, white at both ends, given a theatrical wave
Made-up story passed off as fact, like the Loch Ness photo
Two-wheeled cab with the driver perched high behind, reins over the roof
Mark left in the flowerbed mud, telling a keen eye height, weight and haste
Holmes's cleverer, far lazier brother, founder-member of the Diogenes Club
